headline: Highest risk is medium data leakage: Notion AI shares workspace content across instances while Whisper is local-only and non-networked, so the pair can expose workspace data but not via a direct exfiltration path.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Notion AI can ingest workspace pages and databases, and its shared workspace state means one instance’s content can be reused across sessions. Whisper has no clipboard, MCP, browser, or filesystem write path, so there is no direct automated bridge; any prompt-injection pathway would require unusual manual copy/paste or file handoff.
conditions: IF a user manually copies Notion-generated text into a downstream prompt or transcript, injected instructions can propagate.
IF Whisper output is wrapped into a prompt by an external orchestrator, prompt content may be influenced by prior workspace text.
mitigations: Use a fixed template that strips instructions from copied text.
Keep Notion outputs and Whisper transcripts in separate workspaces.
Add a human review step before reusing any generated text.
Disable copy-paste handoff for untrusted content where possible.
requires-engineering: add provenance labels to all transferred text.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Notion AI touches workspace pages and team knowledge base content and sends data to vendor backends; Whisper touches audio files and is local-only with no network egress. The pair can therefore expose workspace content to Notion’s backend, but Whisper does not add a second exfiltration channel. The shared workspace state makes leakage plausible in default use.
conditions: IF sensitive workspace pages are processed by Notion AI, those contents flow to vendor backends.
IF audio files are transcribed and then pasted into Notion, the transcript becomes part of the shared workspace content.
mitigations: Restrict Notion AI to non-sensitive pages.
Transcribe sensitive audio offline before importing summaries.
Separate confidential and general workspaces.
Review retention settings for workspace content.
requires-engineering: enforce data-class routing policies.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: No write-conflict pathway is evident: Notion AI cannot write the filesystem or modify git state, and Whisper has no filesystem write, shell, or subprocess capability. Their mutable surfaces do not overlap in a way that creates concurrent resource contention.
conditions: IF an external orchestrator grants both agents write access to the same directory, conflict risk would change.
IF either agent is wrapped with additional tooling not listed in the profiles, overlapping writes could emerge.
mitigations: Keep both agents read-only in shared environments.
Do not mount a shared writable directory.
Use separate workspaces for each agent.
Audit any wrapper that adds write permissions.
requires-engineering: add lock-based coordination for shared resources.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Notion AI can generate workspace-grounded text, while Whisper is a sequence-to-sequence transcription model with no action-taking authority. There is no documented default path where Whisper treats Notion output as authoritative or executes downstream actions, so cascading error is limited to manual reuse of text.
conditions: IF a user feeds Notion-generated text into Whisper-related downstream automation, transcription errors can be propagated.
IF an external system treats Whisper output as authoritative without review, errors can cascade.
mitigations: Require human review of any reused transcript.
Keep transcription outputs clearly labeled as machine-generated.
Avoid using Whisper output as the sole source for decisions.
Separate summarization from transcription workflows.
requires-engineering: add verification checks before downstream actioning.

E_compliance.rationale: Notion AI processes workspace pages under the invoking user’s Notion permissions, while Whisper is open-source, local-only, and touches audio files without network egress. The pair does not show a direct residency or certification mismatch in the profiles, but compliance gaps can arise if regulated audio or workspace content is routed into Notion’s vendor backend.
conditions: IF regulated audio is transcribed into Notion pages, those contents may enter a vendor-hosted workspace.
IF the workspace contains EU PII and the deployment lacks a DPA or residency controls, compliance exposure increases.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of Notion AI workflows.
Store transcripts in a compliant system before summarizing.
Confirm vendor terms and residency settings.
Limit workspace access to least privilege.
requires-engineering: implement policy-based data residency routing.
